items.source:
The default implementation is empty. Subclasses can override this method to
convert custom elements into standard Spring bean definitions, for example.
Implementors have access to the parser's bean definition reader and the
underlying XML resource, through the corresponding accessors.
items.translation: 默认实现为空。子类可以重写此方法，例如将自定义元素转换为标准的 Spring  Bean 定义。实现者可以通过相应的访问器获取解析器的 Bean 定义读取器和底层的 XML 资源。

items.source: The structure, elements, and attribute names of the required XML document are hard-coded in this class. (Of course a transform could be run if necessary to produce this format). <beans> does not need to be the root element of the XML document: this class will parse all bean definition elements in the XML file, regardless of the actual root element.
items.translation: 所需 XML 文档的结构、元素和属性名称在此类中硬编码。（当然，如有必要可以运行转换来生成此格式）。`<beans>` 不必是 XML 文档的根元素：此类将解析 XML 文件中的所有 bean 定义元素，无论实际的根元素是什么。

items.source: Opens a DOM Document; then initializes the default settings specified at the <beans/> level; then parses the contained bean definitions.
items.translation: 打开 DOM 文档；然后初始化在 `<beans/>` 级别指定的默认设置；然后解析包含的 Bean 定义。

items.source: Invoke the SourceExtractor to pull the source metadata from the supplied Element.
items.translation: 调用SourceExtractor，从提供的Element中提取源元数据。

items.source: Register each bean definition within the given root <beans/> element.
items.translation: 在给定的根元素<beans/>中注册每个 Bean 定义。

items.source: Return the descriptor for the XML resource that this parser works on.
items.translation: 返回该解析器处理的 XML 资源的描述符。

items.source:
Parse an "import" element and load the bean definitions
from the given resource into the bean factory.
items.translation: 解析“import”元素，并将给定资源中的 Bean 定义加载到 BeanFactory 中。

items.source:
Parse the elements at the root level in the document:
"import", "alias", "bean".
items.translation: 解析文档根级别的元素："import"、"alias" 和 "bean"。

items.source: Process the given alias element, registering the alias with the registry.
items.translation: 处理给定的别名元素，并将该别名注册到注册表中。

items.source:
Process the given bean element, parsing the bean definition
and registering it with the registry.
items.translation: 处理给定的 Bean 元素，解析 Bean 定义并将其注册到注册表中。

items.source: root - the DOM root element of the document
items.translation: root - 文档的 DOM 根元素

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Erik Wiersma
items.translation: Rod Johnson、Juergen Hoeller、Rob Harrop 和 Erik Wiersma

items.source:
Allow the XML to be extensible by processing any custom element types last,
after we finished processing the bean definitions.
items.translation: 通过在我们完成处理 Bean 定义之后最后处理任何自定义元素类型，使 XML 具有可扩展性。

items.source:
Allow the XML to be extensible by processing any custom element types first,
before we start to process the bean definitions.
items.translation: 通过首先处理任何自定义元素类型，然后再开始处理 Bean 定义，使 XML 具有可扩展性。

items.source:
This implementation parses bean definitions according to the "spring-beans" XSD
(or DTD, historically).
items.translation: 此实现根据"spring-beans"XSD（历史上为DTD）解析bean定义。

items.source: readerContext - the current context of the reader (includes the target registry and the resource being parsed)
items.translation: readerContext - 当前读取器上下文（包括目标注册表和正在解析的资源）
